about: Harvey is domain-specific AI for legal and professional services. Adopted by Fortune 500 companies like AT&T, Verizon, Cox, Koch, KKR, Bridgewater, more than 100,000 lawyers across 2,400+ customers in 70 countries and over 75% of AmLaw 100 law firms rely on Harvey to advance legal expertise faster across contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, and litigation. Backed by Sequoia Capital, OpenAI, GV, Kleiner Perkins, Coatue and EQT, Harvey is the trusted partner in modernizing the legal industry.

Finnegan, Henderson, Farabow, Garrett & Dunner, LLP is deploying Harvey firmwide to its legal professionals, advancing the firm’s broader AI innovation strategy and transforming how it serves clients. The firm has built its reputation advising clients on complex intellectual property matters at the intersection of law, science, and technology.

Of the decision, Keith Whitman, Chief Operating Officer at Finnegan, said:

“Expanding Harvey firmwide will help our teams work more efficiently while keeping the expertise and judgment of our people at the center of how we serve our clients. It is also an important step in our broader strategy to combine leading AI technologies with the unique intellectual property knowledge and experience that distinguish Finnegan.”

CEO Winston Weinberg and CPO Anique Drumright took the stage this morning at ILTACON for the Harvey Company Update.

They shared a closer look at Harvey II, what we’ve learned from firm-wide adoption, and what changes when agents start with the context of your work already in place.

Download the slides for the full update.

Harvey now remembers how you work. Today, we’re going deeper on Memory, one of the core capabilities we previewed with Harvey II.

We built this closely with firms and legal teams across the industry, and what we heard was consistent: memory only works in legal if it's transparent and under the user's control. So that's what we built. Every memory is visible, editable, and deletable in one place. Harvey saves nothing without showing exactly what it stored, and never learns silently in the background. Personalization means nothing if you can't trust what's behind it, and that's the bar legal work sets.

Customers are already seeing the difference. As Michelle Mahoney, Chief Innovation Officer at Mallesons, puts it, “One of the most powerful unlocks is in its ability to understand how we each work, not just respond to what we ask.”

Memory is available in Early Access now. Read more: https://lnkd.in/exg7eTtg

Reena SenGupta of RSGI kicked off today’s ILTACON session with findings from RSGI’s latest study with Harvey: Legal AI is moving from adoption to transformation.

She was joined by Thomas Trujillo of McGuireWoods, Michelle Mahoney of Mallesons, and Tania Djerrahian of Davies Ward Phillips & Vineberg on what that transformation actually looks like in practice

From governance and training to targeted use cases and adaptive leadership, the conversation focused on what it takes to build fluency and drive real outcomes.

Harvey is proud to be a launch partner for Google Cloud’s Gemini Enterprise for Legal and to be part of the broader Google ecosystem.

Through an MCP integration, Harvey brings legal reasoning intelligence into Gemini Enterprise, supporting complex legal analysis and multi-source research across Vault projects.

This launch deepens Google and Harvey's existing collaboration across research and product, and is part of Harvey's broader commitment to making legal AI accessible wherever lawyers work.
